data.title: No Place to Hide Update: New Robot & Weapon
data.summary: The fire spreads. The factory wakes. There’s nowhere left to run.
data.meta_title: No Place to Hide Update: New Robot & Weapon
data.meta_description: The fire spreads. The factory wakes. There’s nowhere left to run.
data.content:
Across Tortuga, alarms scream through rusted corridors and neon skylines alike. Old factories roar back to life, weapon systems spin up, and Pilots find themselves hunted in tight spaces where hesitation means destruction.

This update brings relentless new combat tools, a high-stakes Event Pass, and returning simulations designed to test reflexes, pressure control, and raw firepower.

There is no safe ground left.

There is No Place to Hide.

New War Robot: Hitcher

Built for endurance and battlefield control, Hitcher is a War Robot engineered for sustained medium-range engagements. It thrives where firefights drag on, trading blows efficiently, anchoring lanes, and applying constant pressure until enemies crack.

Designed to hold ground and punish overextensions, Hitcher rewards disciplined positioning and steady aggression.

Available in Daily Deals and Direct Offers.

New Weapon: Slugger

Slugger is a light autocannon that delivers devastating damage up close, shredding targets at short range before rapidly losing effectiveness over distance. Perfect for ambushes, brawls, and aggressive flanking tactics, Slugger turns proximity into power.

When fights get personal, Slugger finishes them fast.

Available in Daily Deals and Direct Offers.

New Event Pass: No Place To Hide (January 20 – February 9)

The No Place to Hide Event Pass challenges Pilots to step into relentless combat and emerge armed with elite technology and exclusive customization.

Progress through the Event Pass to unlock:

  • Crix War Robot
  • Stormpike Weapons
  • Hero Pilot Giancarlo
  • Intel and Salvage resources
  • Wraps and Stickers

Every tier pushes you deeper into danger, and closer to dominance.

New Events

Fire Alert! (January 20 – February 3)

Complete 3 battles daily to earn rewards and keep your streak alive. Miss a day, and the fire fades. Stay active to claim all available resources and cosmetic rewards before the alarm goes silent.

Daily Rewards:

  • Day 1: 10,000 Salvage
  • Day 2: Tortuga Firefighters Sticker, 50 Intel
  • Day 3: 10,000 Salvage
  • Day 4: Extreme Heat Decal, 50 Intel
  • Day 5: 10,000 Salvage
  • Day 6: Fire Engine Wrap, 50 Intel
  • Day 7: 10,000 Salvage

How to Participate:

  • Complete your Training Battles to qualify.
  • Play 3 battles and claim rewards as you go.
  • You must receive the previous reward to be eligible for the next one (you can’t skip rewards).

The heat is on.

Intel Discount Event (January 20 – January 27)

This week, the Tortuga engineers invite Pilots to take a closer look at the following builds:

  • War Robot Modules: Phantom, Griffin, Decker
  • Weapons: Lighter, Quantum, Hefty, Jigsaw (Grim Titan)
  • Gear: Holofield, Umbrella, Minefield, Energy Wall, Emergency Shield, Supply Surge

Solidus Node: Foundry (January 20 – February 3)

The industrial nightmare returns.

Solidus Node: Foundry reopens in a dedicated unranked queue, offering close-quarters combat in a stripped-down factory environment built for relentless pressure and unforgiving engagements.

Tight angles. Limited cover. No mercy.

Activate & Dominate!

Jumpstart your No Place To Hide adventure with the OPERATIONSTART promocode! Available from January 20 to February 2, simply activate it on the website to claim a 3-Day Premium Account, 5,000 Salvage, and 50 Intel. 

Don’t miss your chance to power up your roster from day one!

No Escape, No Mercy

Pilots, the factory doors are open, and they won’t stay that way forever.

Arm your Hitcher. Load your Sluggers. Burn through the Event Pass and prove you can survive when escape is no longer an option.

Tortuga is watching.

And this time... there’s No Place to Hide.
